question: Simplify frac{cos 13circ+sin 13circ}{cos 13circ-sin 13circ}
solution: Given :- frac{cos 13∘+sin 13∘}{cos 13∘-sin 13∘} Formula Used :- tanθ = (sintheta)/(costheta) Calculation :- frac{cos 13∘+sin 13∘}{cos 13∘-sin 13∘} Dividing numerator and denominator by cos13° Now, ⇒ (1 +frac{sin13°)/(cos13°)}{1 - (sin13°)/(cos13°)} ⇒ (tanfrac{pi)/(4) + tan13°}{1 - tan(pi)/(4) times tan13°} ⇒ tan(45°+ 13°) ⇒ tan58° 318:T7ef,
